proof_body:
by
  intro f g S hu
  refine Metric.tendstoUniformlyOn_iff.2 fun ε hε => ?_
  obtain ⟨K, hK⟩ := Filter.eventually_atTop.1 (Metric.tendstoUniformlyOn_iff.1 hu (ε / 2) (half_pos hε))
  refine Filter.eventually_atTop.2 ⟨K, fun n hn x hx => ?_⟩
  have a := hK n hn x hx
  have b := hK (n + 1) (hn.trans (Nat.le_succ n)) x hx
  rw [Finset.sum_range_succ] at b
  rw [Real.dist_eq] at a b ⊢
  rw [zero_sub, abs_neg]
  have e : f n x = (g x - ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, f i x) - (g x - (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, f i x + f n x)) := by ring
  rw [e]
  have t := abs_sub (g x - ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, f i x) (g x - (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, f i x + f n x))
  linarith
target_source: ∀ (f : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ) (g : ℝ → ℝ) (S : Set ℝ), TendstoUniformlyOn (fun (N : ℕ) (x : ℝ) => ∑ i ∈ Finset.range N, f i x) g Filter.atTop S → TendstoUniformlyOn f (fun _ => 0) Filter.atTop S
